title: Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.20271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of memecoins on blockchain platforms has increased the risk of fraudulent activities, particularly rug pulls. While previous studies have focused on Ethereum-based tokens, this paper shifts the spotlight to Solana, the leading blockchain for memecoins by trading volume and token count. Unlike Ethereum, where rug pulls often exploit smart contract backdoors, Solana memecoin rug pulls are predominantly driven by liquidity manipulation and social dynamics. This research pioneers large-scale rug pull early detection in the Solana ecosystem by assembling a dataset of 6.4 million tokens over 7 months. Market analysis reveals that a vast majority of these memecoins exhibit rug pull characteristics within one hour of launch, highlighting the urgency of short-horizon prediction. translated_title: 捕捉拉地毯骗局：通过机器学习早期预测Solana上的欺诈性模因币
translated_abstract: 摘要：区块链平台上模因币的迅速激增增加了欺诈活动的风险，尤其是拉地毯骗局。以往研究多聚焦于以太坊代币，而本文将焦点转向Solana，这是按交易量和代币数量计算领先的模因币区块链。与以太坊不同，Solana上的拉地毯骗局主要源于流动性操纵和社会动态，而非智能合约后门。本研究开创性地在Solana生态系统中进行大规模拉地毯骗局早期检测，通过汇编7个月内640万个代币的数据集。市场分析显示，绝大多数此类模因币在发布后一小时内便表现出拉地毯特征，凸显了短时预测的紧迫性。尽管缺乏代码级特征，我们证明经典机器学习模型，尤其是梯度提升（XGBoost），能实现高效预测。
tldr: 本文通过构建640万个Solana模因币数据集，利用经典机器学习模型（如XGBoost）在无代码特征情况下，实现了对拉地毯骗局在发布后一小时内的高效早期预测。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers early rug pull detection on Solana by assembling a dataset of 6.4 million tokens and showing that classic ML models like XGBoost can predict fraudulent memecoins within one hour of launch without code-level features.
